requirementSources.excerpt: Account sanctions require an explicitly eligible ordinary business action, a currently valid full session and an account/session limit excess attributable to that account. Invalid input, missing/expired sessions, exhausted export allowance, network-only excess, callbacks and rights requests cannot accrue sanctions. Count at most one attributable episode per minute. Three within ten minutes cause a ten-minute restriction; recurrence within 48 hours escalates to one hour and then at most 24 hours. The transition increments the account security version and revokes ordinary sessions atomically. Existing rights-only rows do not grant ordinary access; a security-version change requires fresh rights proof.
